_about: Copy this file next to tmr.exe as colours.json and edit it; it is read when the window opens.
Colours are #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB (alpha first). Leave a key out to keep its default; keys starting with _ are ignored.
egui's grey text instead of WinUI's white: dark.text_primary #8C8C8C, light.text_primary #505050.

_keys.text_primary: most text: title, table cells, error lines, card titles, CPU name
_keys.text_secondary: info line, table headings, empty-state lines, chart axis labels
_keys.error: error bullets, a non-zero error count, the chart's error marks
_keys.chart_grid: the chart's gridlines, the header divider
_keys.progress_text: the percentage inside the progress bar
